title: Planar read-back: curve geometry degrades after 3+ commit->rebuild cycles (quadratic read-back accumulation)
description: FIXED (agent-1335). Root cause: insertEdge registered a spurious near-shared-vertex 'crossing' between a closed curved path's consecutive quadratic arcs (they tangent-TOUCH at the shared vertex, not cross) — the snapped hit landed 1-2 twips off the true vertex, spawning a sub-twip stub edge and displacing the boundary chain EVERY rebuild. Reproduced: stroke-free oval read-back gained ~8 stub segs/cycle (8->13->19), 45-deg vertices marched ~1 twip/cycle, fill LOST entirely (paths->0, 0 px) after ~3 cycles. Fix: arrangement.ts insertEdge rejects an interior split whose snapped point is within ~1.5 twips of an endpoint of BOTH edges (shared-vertex tangent touch); genuine crossings (near at most ONE edge's endpoint) are untouched. Result: TRUE FIXED POINT — from cycle 2, read-back is byte-identical to prev cycle (dPixels=0 across 10+ cycles; circles + wide/tall/off-grid ovals; stroked + stroke-free); cycle-1 is one-time sub-pixel twip snap (renders pixel-identical, oracles unaffected). VERIFY: core 5503 pass (only 3 known flash8-empty.fla fixture-ENOENT failures, fixture absent from worktree); swf 1466 pass; authoring-ui 1022 pass; all 121 planar tests pass (+5 new); 8 merge-drawing oracles diff=0/220000. New gate: planar-merge.test.ts 'multi-cycle stability is a fixed point (task 1335)' — 5 tests FAIL pre-fix (fill collapses), PASS post-fix. Docs/36 section 3.0i added. Scope: arrangement.ts (1 guard) + test + docs.
